properties.notes: Extensive coastal cemetery on sand/gravel ridge north of Hammershus (Galgebakken/Stejlebjerg). Excavations in 19771978 recorded a minimum of 400 cremation pit graves across Gebiet I and II, plus 1 stone cist inhumation (1967). Gebiet I contains ~329 uncataloged cremation pits spanning late Pre-Roman Iron Age (PRI) and Early Roman Iron Age (ERI). Gebiet II contains 71 cataloged Roman Iron Age (RKZ) cremation graves (89% ceramics, 17% fibulae, 18% weapons).
